A wonderful hotel
Feb 2025 • Couples
We have been staying at the Avani Resort for the last four nights. It is a lovely peaceful hotel and our room has a wonderful view over the beach and sea. Sadly we have had unusually inclement weather but regardless of this, the hotel and its wonderful staff have been marvellous!!
Do not underestimate what a difference it makes to have such helpful and kind staff. They genuinely seem so happy to help and assist. Being from the UK we are not usually privvy to such a thoughtful and dedicated team. Anything we wanted or needed arrived at our room - pronto!! Housekeeping really needs a mention - thank you so much - beautiful clean beds - floors always pristine- sand always swept away -turn down service and extra towels - super.
The real shining lights in our stay were the breakfast crew, Mi, Linh, Tai and Thao!! But the star of the show was Sunny! She went more than the extra mile to sort out all sorts of extra things and her English was amazing! Thank you everyone at Avani!
